hardCaps.publicInvariant: Each accepted generation has one immutable Release and neither rollback nor PromotionTrain can move another environment backward.
Published revision documents and canonical digests never change and secret-like documents never become visible.
Client resolution and 304 decisions observe the database generation fence and old invalidations cannot re-enable stale content.
Unknown and concurrent mutation replay returns one saved response and creates one generation, Release, invalidation, audit, Work and Event effect.
Claimed Work and dispatcher delivery survive process death without stale commit, lost invalidation or changed Event identity.
Migration preserves V1 revisions, releases, assignments, observations, invalidations, audit, events, Work and replay without synthesizing Trains.

specGaps.summary: No Manager-only Domain Event type name is published; the evaluator invents none.
Cross-environment ConfigRevision identity and copy semantics are unpublished.
CANCELLED and PROMOTION_TRAIN_FROZEN have no public cancel or update mutation.
Only the claimed recovery point is public; later worker barrier points and exact payload are unpublished.
No PromotionTrain GET or list route is published, so refresh-based Train UI read assertions are blocked.
